summary: Hiker found human remains near Mud Lake Open Space property in unincorporated Boulder County near Nederland on Oct 2, 2017; anthropological examination concluded the remains were a male aged 30-60 in the environment less than five years with no match to known missing-person cases; follow-up area searches with Front Range Rescue Dogs found no additional remains or evidence; BCSO case 17-5782; formal identification and cause/manner of death pending with the coroner
location: Mud Lake Open Space near Nederland
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office; Boulder County Coroner; Front Range Rescue Dogs
